objective: Complete the declared finite ED+AD optimization with consistent executable memory and expected raw-input accounting; repair dense curves before updating manuscript conclusions.
user_steering: Reconstruction of the original named four-, five- and sixteen-input circuits is optional. Systematic resource accounting and a self-contained, sufficiently complete protocol class take priority.

assumptions: asymptotic net secret bits per raw pair
source_model.BB84: (1-b-p+z,b-z,z,p-z), 0<=z<=min(b,p), b+p<=1/2; no Werner twirl; production policy independent of hidden z

resource_contract.M: Peak simultaneous live local qubits on any execution branch; includes incoming ports and work ancillas; no external quantum buffer
resource_contract.m: Inputs in a fixed one-pass block; not generally the live memory
resource_contract.successful_ancestry: Raw leaves in a successful tree; distinct from expected consumption
resource_contract.C: Expected raw pairs per accepted measured ED output, including every failed/restarted attempt
resource_contract.terminal_vs_retained: A complete terminal-measurement memory certificate may not be used to count an intermediate preserved quantum output
resource_contract.binary_retry: Each child is regenerated independently until successful; a successful sibling is retained; failed parent discards both; C=(C_left+C_right)/s_parent
resource_contract.fixed_block: All m inputs consumed; each public flag has weight P(flag)/m
resource_contract.classical_B: Measured outputs paired in their public pool; acceptance s; yield s/2; no additional quantum memory
resource_contract.OTP: All masks charged on all processed blocks; signed net costs retained inside BB84 minimization
